name: Long Jing

harvest.pluckingStage: one bud and one or two leaves

processing.description: Hand-plucked in cool Hangzhou spring; earliest flushes fetch the highest prices.
Brief indoor wither to reduce surface moisture before the wok.
Pan-fired in a large wok (杀青) to halt oxidation and set the chestnut aroma.
Pressed and flattened in the wok into the characteristic sword-like leaf.
Low-fire drying to lock the jade colour and toasted-bean sweetness.

profile.mouthfeel: silky, medium body without astringency when brewed cool

infusions.notes: optional 3s rinse; first steep shows the chestnut core

water: Soft water, 30–80 ppm. Alkaline tap water greys the liquor and dulls the nutty top notes.
storage: Airtight, cool, away from light and pantry odours. Drink within 9 months of harvest.
summary: Pan-fired Hangzhou green tea: flattened leaves, chestnut sweetness, and the template for Chinese green-tea craft.
